description: Hook definitions for the sector137 plugin. Commands resolve against ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} so they work from the plugin cache without symlinks. Only the update check is wired. The pre-commit quality gate, UI-change tracker and session-stop summary ship in hooks/ but are unwired: their plain stdout never reaches the model, and in real use 422 design-review nudges produced 0 reviews. rtk-rewrite.sh and gemini-qa-on-todo-complete.sh are likewise unwired — enable any of them yourself.

hooks.description: Notify once/day when this plugin install is behind its marketplace
